Strength Boost Quirk.name: Strength Boost Quirk
Strength Boost Quirk.description:
💪 Your muscles swell on command for bursts of strength far past human.

🌱 At the start a boost lasts about a minute: lift about a ton, punch through a cinder-block wall, throw an adult several meters, hold a fallen beam off a trapped person.
📈 With training: steel doors torn open, crushing holds, rooftop leaps, a collapsing ceiling held up, a speeding truck stopped and, at your peak, an overpass lifted.
⚠️ Swollen hands fumble locks, triggers and injured people.
🔗 Common drawback pairings: Stamina Drain or Finite Fuel, as each boost burns your energy or the fuel you carry.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Rikido Sato (Sugar Rush), Muscular (Muscle Augmentation).

📈 Grants: Power +1, Quirk Output +10, Quirk Stamina +10, Athletics +5, Stamina +10
⚡ Starting techniques: Sledge Blow, Rubble Lift
Strength Boost Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: muscles swell on command for strength far past human. A new adult user bulks up in about a second and, for about a minute per boost, lifts about a ton, punches through a cinder-block wall and throws an adult several meters. Bigger feats need techniques. Limits: strength, not toughness: punching steel still breaks knuckles; blades and bullets cut as deep. No added speed; swollen hands fumble locks, triggers and injured people. Range and an early grapple counter it. Quirk Strain: light: boosted blow; moderate: lift, breach, hold, leap; heavy: holding up a structure, stopping a vehicle; severe: signature blow, lifting an overpass. Type: Transformation. Law: a boosted punch can kill, so police treat an unlicensed user who bulks up in a fight as armed; every injury is judged by the force chosen. Look: the chosen build; in use, arms, shoulders and back swell, veins stand out, sleeves split.
